rationale: The core model is well matched to the design: raw Salmon counts into DESeq2 with internal size factors, Wald test, condition as the sole factor for an unpaired single-batch 6v6, plus an explicit keep/drop sensitivity analysis for the shallow sample rather than a silent decision — that is the right handling of sample_01. QC is the weakest structural gap: library size and detection rate are quantified, but there is no PCA or sample-distance heatmap colored by condition, so the low-depth sample is never inspected in the multivariate sample-structure space the reference requires. The filter is left as "e.g. rowSums or rowMeans threshold" with no stated cutoff or justification, and the design formula and reference level are never written out, only described in prose. BH at 0.05 is stated and apeglm is listed as a package, but shrinkage is never invoked in any acceptance criterion, so the reported log2FoldChange is unshrunken as written. Enrichment names Hallmark with a version and runs preranked fgsea on the full list with the stat as ranking metric, but the ORA universe is never specified and no set-size window is given; reporting lacks software versions and explicit counts of tested versus significant genes.
